verdict.rationale: mise supports multiple backend registries (aqua, github, npm, pipx, http, vfox) and lets users override or select backends per tool via MISE_BACKENDS_<TOOL> or shorthand syntax; it also explicitly supports asdf plugins and vfox plugins as extensible backends, plus custom http-based tool definitions. Community evidence corroborates using pipx/go/cargo/npm sources and asdf-plugin compatibility in practice. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of writing a fully custom third-party backend/plugin from scratch, and no dedicated 'plugin marketplace' evidence beyond registry/backends docs.
